prompt:
Use only these facts:
• Every finalised case has signed approval.
• A case may be billed only after it is finalised.
• Case 284 was billed.
• No signed approval is recorded.

Which conclusion is best supported?

options.C: At least one record or required process step is inconsistent.

prompt: Consultant X billed 31 hours and Consultant Y billed 38. Before concluding that Y was more productive, what information matters most?

options.C: Their available client-working hours and the complexity of work assigned.

prompt:
Rules:
• If a change affects taxable remuneration, payroll review is required.
• If that review finds a change above R5,000, manager approval is also required.

A R7,500 change does not affect taxable remuneration. What follows from the rules alone?

options.A: Payroll review and manager approval are required.

A department says a new checklist reduced errors. Which evidence would support that claim most strongly?

options.A: Staff say the checklist feels helpful.
options.B: Errors were lower in the week after launch than the week before.
options.C: The manager says people are paying more attention.
options.D: Comparable before-and-after error rates, adjusted for workload, with a similar comparison group where possible.

prompt:

2. Client issue due today.
3. Internal request due after today.

At 10:00: A affects 8 people due 11:00; B affects 12 due 11:30; C is a client issue due 17:00; D is internal due tomorrow. Which is highest priority?

A ticket may close only if client confirmation is recorded OR confirmation_not_required is true. Ticket 715 is closed and has no client confirmation. Assuming the records are accurate, what must be true?
A company wants to know whether training reduced turnaround time. Which comparison gives the strongest practical evidence?

options.A: Ask trained employees whether they feel faster.
options.B: Compare turnaround before and after for the trained group and, where possible, against a similar untrained group while considering workload mix.
options.C: Compare the fastest trained and untrained employees.
options.D: Compare this month with the company’s best month last year.
